themes.theme: Houthi strikes on Saudi energy infrastructure
themes.summary: Houthis claimed strikes on Abqaiq, Rabigh and Ras Tanura; Brent spiked to $114.06/b for January contract and Dec Brent settled at $117.64/b.
Hormuz transits rose to 26 on Oct. 29 but attacks, a mine report and tanker fires continued; Sinopec and Korean refiners cite persistent Hormuz uncertainty.
Reports of Vance outreach to Iran pushed crude benchmarks lower on the week, though escalation concerns kept a floor under prices.

themes.theme: Elevated freight, premiums and refining margins
themes.summary: BP margin $46.70/b, Sinopec expects premiums, freight and insurance above $15/b in Q4, Moeve cites higher crude premiums and freight.
ExxonMobil said product shortage may last well through next year; Russian diesel exports and Valero Houston restart are partial offsets.
South Korea imported record Americas crude (191.4 million barrels Jan-Sep) with WTI Midland at $26.80/b over Dubai DES Yeosu.
Venezuela, Permian, Nigeria and Pemex show output or runs growth, with Venezuela at 1.218 million b/d in September.
